sections.content: How many people are "air-conditioning and refrigeration installers and repairers"?

12,755 people

were counted on the census as "air-conditioning and refrigeration installers and repairers" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Air-conditioning and refrigeration installers and repairers install, service and repair air-conditioning and refrigeration systems in factories, offices, shops and homes.

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "air-conditioning and refrigeration installers and repairers" there were more men than women (99.3% compared with 0.7%).

This means "air-conditioning and refrigeration installers and repairers" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades".

Men made up 99.3% and women made up 0.7% of "air-conditioning and refrigeration installers and repairers"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "air-conditioning and refrigeration installers and repairers" included:

  • bricklayers
  • roofers, roof tilers and slaters
  • scaffolders, stagers and riggers

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

People who had this job were generally similar in age to the working population

The occupation of "air-conditioning and refrigeration installers and repairers" had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 30 to 34 years. Of the whole working population 12% were aged 30 to 34 years. For people working as "air-conditioning and refrigeration installers and repairers", 14.4% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "air-conditioning and refrigeration installers and repairers" was 16 to 19 years.

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "air-conditioning and refrigeration installers and repairers", 5.7% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (91.7% compared with 8.3%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (77%) than self-employed (23%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Medway, this is in the same region of the South East.
